'''2013 Worlds Day 1 Nathan Way DS Contract Killers''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nathan Way]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
